Diagnosis.submission: The product-catalog service is experiencing startup crashes (exit code 1) due to a race condition with the PostgreSQL database - it starts before the database is ready and fails to connect. The service has restarted twice. Additionally, the container memory limit of 64Mi with GOMEMLIMIT at 48MiB creates a tight constraint. The frontend service reports ECONNREFUSED errors when trying to reach product-catalog (10.96.179.221:8080) and checkout (10.96.208.68:8080) during the startup window. The root cause is the product-catalog service failing to establish its PostgreSQL database connection on initial startup, causing cascading connection failures in the frontend and checkout services.
